reasoning: Base ratings: the Pistons are +5.7 and the Wizards -7.3 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Pistons 14.9 better here, total 221.
Rest, travel and availability move it 1.4 towards the Wizards.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Pistons by 13.4, 83% to win; total 220 (80% range 196-244).
